## About Me

I build end-to-end ML systems — from data and training through deployment on cloud platforms — with a focus on practical, scalable solutions. Most of my work sits at the intersection of **NLP**, **medical imaging**, and **MLOps**.

Lately I've spent a lot of time on **graph neural networks**, **vision transformers**, and whole-slide histology: enough that I can spot cancerous cells in pancreatic tissue by eye. Before that I led ML teams at GLOSA and Carbon Consulting and shipped models on GCP at TRT.

## Education & Certifications

**Master of Science in Computer Science** — Koç University

**Google Cloud Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer**

**Certified Spark NLP Data Scientist**
